# kernel_name: # Int8 MMQ GEMM of the llama.cpp MMQ weight types, its split-K twin and the small-token-tile _S
# twins and their S64 ladder row (kernels/llm/matmul_mmq.cl via kernels/llm/common/matmul_mmq_family.h),
# the cooperative-matrix GEMM of the dense 16-bit weight types (kernels/llm/matmul_mma.cl via
# kernels/llm/common/matmul_mma_family.h), the quantized-weight cooperative-matrix GEMM and its
# split-K twin (shaders/llm/matmul_mmq_cm.comp; their portable scalar rows are kernels/llm/matmul_cm.cl),
# the split-K reduce (kernels/llm/split_k_reduce.cl), and the workgroup-scope cooperative-matrix GEMM of
# VK_NV_cooperative_matrix2 over the quantized types and dense F16 (shaders/llm/matmul_mmq_cm2.comp; the
# F16 rows load the halves directly, NF_CM2_DENSE; the _CM2V rows decode four weight elements per callback through
# VK_NV_cooperative_matrix_decode_vector, NF_CM2_DECODE_VECTOR; the _N128 rows run the 128-token tile, NF_CM2_BN=128,
# without a split-K twin) with its fp16 activation staging
# (shaders/llm/stage_f16.comp). Both are Vulkan-only (flag vulkan: no OpenCL twin, no Metal translation,
# exempt from the inventory and coverage checks); vk13 compiles a row for the Vulkan 1.3 environment,
# and noopt keeps the CM2 modules as glslc emits them: spirv-opt flattens their unrolled tensor loads and
# the driver then compiles each pipeline several times slower.
